data.title: A2 · 维修室的灯
data.description: A2 换下战斗装，穿着宽松衬衫坐在维修台边，低头检查手臂上的擦痕。工具放在一旁，她暂时没有去拿。
data.promptProse: Sitting beside a sturdy metal workbench in a maintenance room, A2 examines a minor scratch on her synthetic forearm under an overhead incandescent work lamp. Wrenches, spare mechanical components, and tools are neatly arranged on the steel table beside her.
data.animaCaption: The repair tools remain on the bench beside her. The workbench lamp lights her face, arm and the tools around the repair room.
